lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Spreadsheet Dimension. Everything that happens in Glimmerdale... is calculated HERE first. We are inside the math, hero.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Are WE in a cell somewhere?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Row 7, column YOU. I checked. Your formula is beautiful. Don't let anyone edit it.

lines.speaker: Pivot Dragon
lines.text: I HAVE SUMMARIZED YOUR PARTY BY ELEMENT. WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE YOURSELVES... AS PERCENTAGES?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Pivot Dragon
lines.text: DRAGGING YOU TO THE VALUES SECTION ANYWAY.
The center of the grid. A formula older than counting glows in the bar above the world.

lines.speaker: The First Formula
lines.text: =SUM(EVERYTHING). I HAVE BEEN CALCULATING THE FINAL TOTAL SINCE TIME BEGAN. YOU ARE A ROUNDING ERROR.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Rounding errors CHANGE OUTCOMES, buddy!

lines.speaker: The First Formula
lines.text: ...RECALCULATING.

lines.speaker: The First Formula
lines.text: CALCULATION... COMPLETE. THE FINAL TOTAL IS... FRIENDSHIP?? CHECKING MY REFERENCES—

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The math has spoken, hero, and honestly? I did NOT expect the math to be a coward about it.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: One chapter left. Whoever runs ALL of this... is expecting us.
Row 7. The party finds a highlighted range: HERO, PIP, PARTY(3). Formula: =JOURNEY(A1:NOW()).

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: It's us, hero. Our whole adventure, calculated. Look — chapter one is just "=SLIME(1)". We were so young.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What's the formula outputting now?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: #GROWING. It's not an error, hero. It's a compliment.
The lights die. In the darkness, a soft, terrible question forms.

lines.speaker: Ghost of Unsaved Work
lines.text: did you save

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: WE SAVE CONSTANTLY. WE SAVE AFTER EVERY STAGE. TELL IT, HERO.

lines.speaker: Ghost of Unsaved Work
lines.text: that is what they all believed
The formula bar stretches over the horizon, glowing with the First Formula. Beneath it, a sticky note in Pip's handwriting: "Almost finale. Box time soon. — P."

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Past-me strikes again! She KNEW, hero. Whatever's in that box, it matters for what comes next.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: One dimension at a time. First: the math.
